title: Factorization of Isomorphisms of $(H,θ)$-twisted Lie algebroids
summary: We study the isomorphism groupoid $\mathcal{T}(M)$ of $θ$-almost twisted Poisson ($θ$-atP) structures on a smooth manifold $M$, focusing on the internal structure of its morphisms. A morphism in $\mathcal{T}(M)$ is a $C^\infty(M)$-linear isomorphism $Φ:\gO^1(M)\to\gO^1(M)$ that simultaneously intertwines the anchor maps and the $(H,θ)$-twisted Koszul brackets associated with two $θ$-atP structures.
